test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four elements have been listed, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Neon, Argon and Helium are the noble gases or inert gases but sodium is an alkali metal.

So, Sodium is different from other.

Hence, **"Sodium"** is the correct answer.
